policy: Limits are ratchets. Lower them after reductions; raise them only with an explicit context-budget justification.
adjustment_justification: Validated lookup indices now live in the schema-of-record IR and explicit per-executor tuning now lives in sembla-cpu. The backend remains 1,672 tokens below the original 178,920-token ratchet; function, complexity, file, and IR limits remain lowered.
